title: Update expense VAT specification source
summary: Expense Agent now tracks whether VAT specifications were created by the API or manually, prevents modifications to API-created records, and improves error messages when posting expense reports with pending VAT reclaim status.
key_points: Added Source field to VAT specification records to distinguish API-created (Agent) from manually-created (Manual) entries
Enforced immutability for API-created VAT specifications to prevent unauthorized modifications or deletions
Skipped certain validations and calculations for agent-created records to handle them differently
Enhanced error messages during expense report posting with specific guidance for resolving VAT reclaim issues
Added upgrade logic and comprehensive test coverage for the new VAT specification handling
